name: pylos
description: The forever chat. One conversation, every model, nothing forgotten silently.

scripts.test: bun test --cwd packages/core --timeout 60000 && bun test --cwd packages/server --timeout 60000 && bun test --cwd apps/app && bun test --cwd apps/web
scripts.test:release-contract: bun run test:semantic-assets && bun run test:bench-contract
scripts.lint: bunx biome check packages apps bench scripts
scripts.format: bunx biome format --write packages apps bench scripts
